sources.title: Microduck - ROBOTS: Your Guide to the World of Robotics
sources.snippet: Microduck is a small biped robot with a distinctly ducklike waddle. Using AI skills, it can walk, sit, roller-skate, pick up objects with its beak, recover from falls, and quack in its own voice. Designed for developers, researchers, and robotics enthusiasts, it ships assembled, uses open-source software tools, and offers a playful platform for training, testing, and sharing new behaviors.

sources.title: Hugging Face Unveils Microduck, New Open-Source Biped AI Robot
sources.snippet: Hugging Face, an organisation known for its open-source artificial intelligence models, has unveiled a new biped robot named Microduck. This device is 25 centimetres tall, weighs 800 grams, and is priced at USD 399. Pre-orders for Microduck commenced on Aug. 27, with shipping anticipated before Christmas 2026.

sources.snippet: Hugging Face's Pollen Robotics has introduced Microduck, a small biped robot designed as an open development platform for experimenting with physical AI, reinforcement learning and transferring robot behaviors from simulation into real hardware.
